mentions.name: ShotBrief
mentions.description: ShotBrief tells photographers whether tomorrow is worth going out to a shoot location, combining weather, sunrise and sunset times, moon phase, aurora conditions where applicable, and an overall go/no-go score for the whole day.
mentions.problem: The author likes going out early for photography but also likes sleeping in, so the app tells them whether it's worth waking up early for good shoot conditions.
mentions.audience: Photographers deciding whether conditions are worth an early outing to a shoot location; described for the author's own personal use balancing early photography trips with sleeping in.
mentions.source_excerpt: ShotBrief answers whether tomorrow is worth going out at your shoot location, weather, sunrise and sunset, moon phase, aurora where it applies, and a go/no-go score for the whole day.
mentions.author: bigwindow1
